text: Until the sources name them, the X1 dispute and complaint harness is assumed to run from one harness package in SIT, against the stubs from Day 1 and the real owners as RWB-S8-E7001-APP lands, on one synthetic case in an active stage with a stage clock and a prescription clock, one X1 deviation, one complaint reference, three evidence-pack documents and one business date; the complaint outcome and reason codes are fixture data in the R-DEV-09 and R-DEV-20 values; the P5 documents answer is metadata only, with type, version and retention class and no content; the evidence is one report per story and case_no carrying the pre-flag snapshot beside the post-clear read and one row per criterion, hop and timer, retained with the release record; and the gate passes only when every owned criterion is green with RWB-S8-E7001-APP in place, with each hop named as the owner or as a stub and no stub pass reported as a real pass.
why: The story needs an environment, a fixture layout, synthetic keys, an outcome code set, a documents answer shape, an evidence artefact and a gate to be testable and repeatable, and no source gives any of them; the legacy story predates the split into services and names no harness artefact.
read: Read as test-only defaults that change no production behaviour: the harness calls only the owning services and their fakes, owns no table, writes no row of rwb_deviation or rwb_case, and no value here is a business value that a business person may change.
applied_in: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan (environment and test data, build steps, done when); 15 Screens and states
confirm: The integration lead and the QA lead confirm the base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic keys, the outcome and reason codes, the documents answer shape, the evidence format and retention and the gate before the wave entry check; the S8 owner confirms the outcome code set of R-DEV-09 with the R-DEV-20 service level.
impact: Low: the rules, the states, the messages and the owners are fixed; only the harness packaging, the fixture values, the evidence artefact and the gate move, and no production story is blocked by the assumption.
